description: This file contains API client functions for authentication-related operations, including fetching user organizations by email and logging in with email and password. It imports configuration, utility functions, and URL resolution helpers, and exports functions that perform network requests and handle responses.

methods.name: fetchUserOrganizationsByEmail
methods.description: Fetches organizations associated with a given email address by making a GET request to the API.

methods.name: loginWithOrgEmailPassword
